site_name: Bestwood Road - Former Bestwood Day Centre
evidence_slice: Nottingham City Council's adopted Local Plan page states that the Land and Planning Policies Document (Local Plan Part 2) was adopted on 13 January 2020 and contains site-specific land allocations. The Council's own OpenData MapServer layer 62 is 'Local Plan Site Allocations 2020', a Feature Layer with esriGeometryPolygon geometry, display field SITE_NAME, EPSG:27700 and query support including GeoJSON. Official Policy SA1 material identifies site allocation PA1 as 'Bestwood Road - Former Bestwood Day Centre' in Bulwell, and the Inspector's report confirms PA1 as a residential-development allocation.
